clips.title: The story
paras: Along Teldrassil's shores, Laird's Response carries a puzzle for Nessa Shadowsong. The fish there are larger and more plentiful than those along mainland Darkshore.

Laird compares catches from across the Veiled Sea. Fish from Teldrassil's coast are larger and more plentiful than those from Darkshore's mainland beaches. In his reply to Nessa Shadowsong, Laird of Auberdine offers a theory: the newly planted World Tree's unusual presence and vitality may be changing the surrounding sea life. Travelers carry his letter across the water to Rut'theran Village, where the fisherfolk greet the news with wonder and quiet curiosity.
